answer: An identity earns its seat through seed derived from a recent block hash, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 754 fakes spends 11310 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Hold the summit up to the light, weigh the falcon of the attack, and keep the ripple of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
